introduction: This project adds a small, reusable Apex utility class, RefundEligibilityChecker, that tells callers whether a purchase is still inside its return window. It is intended for developers and admins who need a single, consistent eligibility check from other Apex code, flows, or components.

requirements.title: RefundEligibilityChecker Apex Class
requirements.description: As a developer, I want an Apex class RefundEligibilityChecker with a static isEligible method so that I can check whether a purchase is still within its return window.
acceptance_criteria: An Apex class named RefundEligibilityChecker exists (no existing class with this name was found in the org).
It exposes a public static method Boolean isEligible(Date purchaseDate, Integer returnWindowDays).
The method returns true when Date.today() is on or before purchaseDate plus returnWindowDays days; otherwise false.
The method returns false when purchaseDate or returnWindowDays is null, or returnWindowDays is negative.
The class does not perform DML or SOQL.
An Apex unit test can be generated afterwards via Tribal's Trust step covering: within window, exactly on last day, past window, and null/negative inputs.

glossary: Apex class: Server-side Salesforce code unit. Static method: A method called on the class itself without creating an instance. Return window: The number of days after purchase during which a refund or return is allowed. Eligible: Today's date is on or before the purchase date plus the return window days.
